## Summary
WhatTheyThink's sponsored "Product Spotlight" piece on Infigo. Sponsored by Infigo (so editorial slant is favorable) but Infigo had no editorial control over content per WTT's disclosure. Useful for documenting how the broader trade press describes the modular platform structure (Catfish → MegaEdit PRO → MegaEdit PHOTO → Catfish Hybrid Mail → Symphony).

## Key takeaways
- **Disclosure:** Sponsored content. WTT retained editorial control; Infigo reviewed final article for accuracy.
- **Modular platform breakdown (trade-press framing):**
  - Catfish = base web-to-print storefront
  - MegaEdit PRO = personalization editor
  - MegaEdit PHOTO = photo products
  - Catfish Hybrid Mail = hybrid mail
  - Symphony = marketing automation / cross-media campaigns
- **WTT's editorial take:** "Infigo brings a much needed drive to innovate into the industry. The innovation focus has the proper balance between what the printer wants and what will make the printer successful with their customer."
- **Frame to repeat:** Infigo's product center of gravity is UX/UI ("that's the whole product to the printer's customers") — distinct from MIS-first vendors.
- Mobile/responsive design called out as core.
